description: 3D PieChart is a custom visual for Microsoft Power BI that divides data into colored slices, each representing a category with size proportional to its share of the whole. The 3D effect adds visual depth, with adjustable settings, such as 3D height, 3D width (X-axis), 3D rotation (Y-axis), and general rotation, for further customization. Additional features include category labels, dynamic colors, interactive tooltips, optional legends, and animations. Users can click slices to filter your data, making it an ideal visual for exploring parts-to-whole relationships with added dimensionality. Key features Donut chart conversion-: Convert your 3D Pie chart into a modern donut chart with just a click. Customize the inner radius to adjust the thickness of the donut, enabling a tailored view that fits your analysis needs. Series-: Controls the maximum number of pie slices displayed, allows reversing slice order, and groups extra categories into an aggregated "Other" slice with customizable label, color, and pattern. Background-: Customizes the visual's appearance with background color, transparency, gradient, shadow, blur, border, corner radius, and padding for a polished look. Data Colors-: Provides multiple color palette options (Single, Power BI Theme, Gradient, By Category, Sequential, Diverging, and Qualitative) to customize slice colors and maintain report consistency.…
keywords: 3D PieChart and Donut Chart by iFour
